title: Lucene matches a numeric range on a sorted index
summary: The parent threw ClassCastException from both hit enumeration and count. The fix returned only document B and counted one, including in reverse order. An independent point query agreed on every index.

change.description: The parent is expected to throw ClassCastException on the affected path. The merge returns only B and counts 1.

notes: Each history starts in a fresh JVM on each measured deployment and uses the same compiled caller on both revisions.
